newsitem.title: SWEDEN: MoDo to up sulphate, cut sulphite output.
newsitem.headline: MoDo to up sulphate, cut sulphite output.

text.p: Swedish forestry group MoDo AB said on Monday it would propose increasing sulphate pulp production at the Husum mill and closing the sulphite pulp mill at Domsjo, both in Sweden.

MoDo said in a statement its president Bengt Pettersson had informed the board that he wanted to raise the capacity of the Husum sulphate pulp mill from around 600,000 tonnes annually to about 800,000 tonnes.
He would also propose closing the Domsjo sulphite pulp mill with its annual production of 200,000 tonnes.
"It's more rational to make 800,000 tonnes annually at one mill than to produce the same quantity in two places," Pettersson said.
